title: Pantowin price ceiling
description: Government price ceiling on pantoprazole 40 mg cuts Pantowin trade price ~20%; FY2024 Pantowin sales fall ~12%.

title: Kochi branch opens
description: Kochi branch opens for Kerala: 12 medical reps by Mar 2024, 19 by Mar 2025, 24 by Mar 2026. Set-up cost INR 40 lakh in Q2 FY2024.

title: Chennai flooding
description: Cyclone-related flooding disrupts Chennai depot dispatches; Chennai December sales down ~20%.

title: Client A contract ends
description: Client A moves production in-house; ~INR 3.8 Cr a year of contract revenue lost.

title: Online pharmacy partnerships
description: Distribution through two online pharmacy partners expanded.

title: Vildora M launched
description: Vildagliptin + metformin launched in all three branches; dedicated tender manager hired in Chennai.

title: Tamil Nadu tender won
description: 18-month state supply contract (Oct 2024 - Mar 2026) for paracetamol, azithromycin, cefixime and metformin; ~INR 8.3 Cr total.

title: Dermatology product manager
description: Product manager hired to lead the dermatology range ahead of Acneclear.

title: Acneclear Gel launched
description: Adapalene + clindamycin gel launched; strongest in Bengaluru.

title: Client C signed
description: New contract manufacturing client; 8 production operators hired; validation batches cost INR 25 lakh in Q2 FY2026.

title: Metformin shortage
description: Raw-material shortage cuts Metfora, Glimora and Vildora supply ~28% in Nov-Dec 2025; tender supply protected.

title: WHO-GMP certification
description: Bengaluru plant receives WHO-GMP certification, opening export tenders from FY2027.

title: Hyderabad branch approved
description: Board approves a fourth branch in Hyderabad for FY2027.
